purpose: Teach: 亭主/眼差し/就く/むかっ/無くなり/申さ/ゆけ/沈み

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは家の亭主ね
lines.en: Sho, your father is the heart of our home, you know.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact observation. Gentle pride in the statement. Speaking as much to herself as to him. Settled and sure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの優しい眼差しに守られてるよ
lines.en: Mom, I feel safe when Dad looks at me that way.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. The voice of a child discovering something true about himself. Quiet certainty. Slightly trailing, like he's sharing a secret he just understood.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが部長職に就く事になられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been promoted to manager.
lines.style: Bright announcement with underlying warmth. Light emphasis on the news itself. Pleased but grounded — this is good, and she's sharing it plainly with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんにむかって走ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I ran toward Dad as fast as I could.
lines.style: Excited, breathless. The remembered energy of movement. Immediate and unguarded. Slight rise at the end — wanting her to feel his joy too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おやつが無くなりそうだから、お父さんに頼みましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we're running low on snacks — shall we ask Dad to pick some up?
lines.style: Practical, gentle. A soft suggestion rather than a directive. Warmth underneath the logistics. The tone of a mother including her son in small decisions.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「お願いします」って度々申されてるよ
lines.en: Mom, I keep asking Dad very politely if he can help.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly proud of himself. The careful formality of a child trying his best to be respectful. Seeking her approval gently. Small and genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと公園にゆけば楽しいわよ
lines.en: Sho, you and Dad always have fun at the park together.
lines.style: Encouraging, lightly nostalgic. Soft certainty — she's observed this. Warmth without pushing. Inviting him to remember something good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが落ち込んで気持ちが沈みそうな日もあるよ
lines.en: Mom, sometimes Dad gets really sad and I can feel it, even when he tries to hide it.
lines.style: Quiet and perceptive, with the weight of noticing something an adult might miss. Gentle concern underneath. Slow pace. Trailing off softly at the end — he's shared something that worries him.
